finding: collect01 through collect14 are copy-paste of a single implementation -- identical totalling, identical mean, identical response object -- except that one of them silently reports the wrong source string, which would make the alerting pipeline attribute its reading to the wrong stage. collector12 and collector13 also report a source that differs from their own function name, but docs/PATCH-NOTES.md records that -v2 rename as a deliberate, sanctioned amendment to the naming rule, so neither is an actual violation.
constraint: The `source` field a collector returns has to be spelled the same as the function emitting it; INGEST.md says the alerting pipeline keys on that string and a mismatch fires the alert against the wrong collector while the real one stays silent.
